ragMatches.resolutionNotes: Fitted new brass compression washer and tested for 30 minutes under static pressure.

metadata.title: Cafeteria Sink Cold Water Pipe Leak
metadata.description: Slow drip on cold water feed under counter. Replaced compression ring and tightened valve shutoff.
metadata.rootCause: Degraded compression fitting due to thermal contraction.
metadata.fixApplied: Fitted new brass compression washer and tested for 30 minutes under static pressure.

ragMatches.resolutionNotes: Shifted rack 3 power distributor to phase A; load dropped below 80% breaker rating.

metadata.title: Keller Science Server Room Breaker Trip
metadata.description: Sub-panel 40A circuit breaker tripped under heavy compute load. Reset breaker and rebalanced phase B.
metadata.rootCause: Phase imbalance causing transient amp spike on single leg.
metadata.fixApplied: Shifted rack 3 power distributor to phase A; load dropped below 80% breaker rating.

ragMatches.resolutionNotes: High-temp synthetic grease injected into bearing nipple.

metadata.title: Carrow Library Rooftop Chiller Noise
metadata.description: Chiller fan bearing chirping at high RPM. Lubricated bearing assembly and realigned fan shroud.
metadata.rootCause: Dry bearing housing after hot summer run cycle.
metadata.fixApplied: High-temp synthetic grease injected into bearing nipple.
